dedupe_keys.name: influence of stratigraphic variability and ground motion properties on the effectiveness of dense granular columns as liquefaction mitigation for structures

description: Influence of Stratigraphic Variability and Ground Motion Properties on the Effectiveness of Dense Granular Columns as Liquefaction Mitigation for Structures is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Caroline Bessette, University of Colorado Boulder (colorado.edu). This research aims to investigate the seismic performance of Dense Granular Columns (DGCs) used to mitigate liquefaction in sites with complex, stratigraphically variable soil conditions. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-kyvb-jn79. Keywords: Liquefaction,  Soil-Structure Interaction,  Mitigation,  Dense Granular Columns,  Interlayering,  Stratigraphic Variability. Published 2025-02-07. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
